args.prompt: Crowd bobs; sunlight flares under the overpass. The underpass at sunrise: the mural has been repainted so a single chalk line now connects the two charts; the whole block is here; FAST and SLOW stand back to back in the middle. Camera: The chorus-anchor wide, now in warm light. 1990s hand-painted cel anime, warm golden sunrise light, film grain. Keep the art style, characters, faces, hair, outfits and any lettering exactly as in the first frame. Characters do not speak or sing; mouths stay closed or relaxed. No new text or subtitles.
args.negative_prompt: 3D render, CGI, photorealistic, morphing, warped faces, extra limbs, extra people, subtitles, captions, watermark, text changes
